omar (product): Quick heads-up: launching a new 'Unified Burst Credit Pool' for hosted customers. Purpose: give teams a shared, automated safety buffer to absorb short token spikes without immediate overage charges. Rollout planned 2026-04-10 09:00 UTC. Details below.
nina (finance): How will this appear on invoices?
li (billing): Any credit applied from the pool will show as a single line item 'burst-credit-pool' and will not change revenue recognition unless pool payouts for an account exceed $400/month. We'll log event metadata for audit.
drew (eng): Implementation notes: new service (burst-pool) monitors per-account short-window delta (default 60s) and issues credits if spike meets policy criteria. No changes to rate-limit headers; this is purely post-facto billing mitigation.
tara (support): Need canned responses and opt-out option for enterprise orgs. We'll also want an internal triage list for accounts that exhaust their pool repeatedly.
omar (product): Policy bullets:
- Default pool: $100/account/month reusable credit (configurable by account tier)
- Per-incident cap: $50
- Auto-apply only for transient spikes <= 10s and <= 20% above baseline
- If account uses >50% of monthly pool in a 7-day window, flag for manual review
- Enterprise customers can opt out or set custom pool sizes in billing console
nina (finance): Also: temporarily suppress immediate charge attempts for accounts that receive a burst-credit within the billing window to avoid charge-and-refund churn. Approved.
li (billing): Dashboards: added Billing -> BurstPool shows pool balance, applied credits, and flagged accounts. We'll emit alerts when pool burn rate >5% of active customers in a region.
drew (eng): Rollout plan:
1) 09:00 UTC: enable monitoring + audit-only credits in us-central-canary
2) 09:30: observe for 1h, then enable auto-apply at 10% traffic
3) 11:00: ramp to 100% over 2 hours if safe
Kill-switch: feature-flag to disable pool instantly.
tara (support): Customer message draft: "We're introducing a Burst Credit Pool to reduce surprise overages from short bursts. You can opt out or customize limits in Billing Settings. Credits will show on your invoice as 'burst-credit-pool'."
omar (product): Final: internal runbook and FAQ at https://redwood.internal/docs/burst-credit-pool. We'll post canned replies and escalation contacts there. sysbot: scheduled: burst-pool-service v0.9.0 -> us-central-canary at 2026-04-10T09:00:00Z.
